release.source_sha256_algorithm: sha256 of contracts/accord.py with line endings normalized to LF
release.status: canonical release — deployed source is content-identical to contracts/accord.py; all 17 methods and empty-index views verified live

review_requirements.freshness: undated evidence is STALE under every non-zero freshness requirement and cannot steer time-sensitive results
review_requirements.layered_evidence_state: availability, claim presence and freshness are independent; readable no-claim pages complete as unresolved evidence
review_requirements.classification_accuracy: one shared classifier preserves supporting, conflicting, uncontested, no-claim, excluded and unavailable records
review_requirements.dependency_cycles: publisher grouping detects citation loops explicitly and collapses each loop to one deterministic voice
review_requirements.validity_and_finality: validity has a 360-second floor; proposals finalized after expiry become EXPIRED, never current
review_requirements.source_integrity: each readable page stores an unmasked exact whole-page digest for provenance and a separate figure-masked digest for consensus comparison
review_requirements.date_provenance: date_basis separates a page-stated claim date from HTTP Last-Modified metadata
review_requirements.long_page_coverage: head-plus-tail excerpts carry an omission marker and an excerpted flag; no omitted passage can ground a claim

verification.schema_pinning: the interface checks all 17 method names, parameter order and payable flags, then performs a live get_protocol_info round-trip

notes: This is the only contract address referenced by the application, documentation, tests and CI.
docs/live-e2e.json is the executed transaction record produced by scripts/lifecycle_e2e.py; scripts/render_e2e.py renders it into docs/e2e.md.
